items.name: Workshop participant
items.quote: I found his entire curriculum to be effectively planned and structured. He introduced new concepts and exercises at a natural and helpful pace, ensuring we had time to absorb, take notes and implement in action everything we learned. We would all jump at the chance to learn from him again.

items.name: Workshop participant
items.quote: Ivano is a wonderful, observant and thoughtful teacher. His classes always feel like a playground to experiment and explore different forms. He has an innate ability to create a warm, inviting atmosphere which helped me be more of myself.

items.name: Workshop participant
items.quote: Ivano does not simply teach techniques; he guides you through a personal journey, helping you overcome physical, emotional, or expressive blocks. His attention to each individual student is sincere and consistent.

items.name: Former student
items.quote: He has been one of the best teachers I have ever had. His humor and the irony with which he approaches each lesson are contagious. A true great professional, both as an actor and as a teacher, and on a human level, a truly wonderful person.

items.name: Workshop participant
items.quote: Ivano is an extremely knowledgeable, precise, and reliable professional. One of the things I appreciated most is the seriousness he brings to the work, conveyed with remarkable lightness. A rare encounter that undoubtedly leaves a lasting mark.
